exposure: Women with both anemia and low BMI
Timing of anemia (any time during pregnancy, at delivery)
cohort: 72,750 pregnant women in Eastern Maharashtra, India
finding: Maternal anemia, especially when combined with low BMI, was associated with an increased risk of stillbirth, neonatal death, and low birth weight.
mod_finding: Obesity/overweight during pregnancy was associated with an increased risk of cesarean section.
